_meta.purpose: Story case: 3rd-party card provider took a maintenance window that blocked its own DB, causing our payment service's outbound calls to time out. Reproduces author's own production experience (anonymized). Pattern is DEP — downstream dependency (in this case external) becomes unavailable.
